videos.title: Essentials: How Emotions & Social Factors Impact Learning | Dr. Mary Helen Immordino-Yang
videos.description:
In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Mary Helen Immordino-Yang, EdD, a professor of education and psychology at the University of Southern California (USC) and director of the USC Center for Affective Neuroscience, Development, Learning and Education (CANDLE). We discuss how emotions, stories and culture shape the way we perceive the world, learn and build a sense of self. We also explain how our narratives can foster empathy or dehumanization, and how education can be redesigned to engage curiosity, meaning-making and the development of the whole person.

Show notes: https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/essentials-how-emotions-and-social-factors-impact-learning-mary-helen-immordino-yang

videos.title: How to Cancel Plans Without Hurting Anyone
videos.description: Canceling plans doesn't have to mean hurting someone's feelings or making up an elaborate excuse. Sometimes, you just don't have the energy to socialize, and that's perfectly reasonable. The key is how you communicate it. A little honesty, reassurance, and genuine effort to reschedule can go a long way in showing someone you still value the relationship, even when you're not up for hanging out.
